Unfortunately, she is also the least intelligent character in BlazBlue. Like most cats, Taokaka's daily routine consists of eating and sleeping, and she can, and often will, forget anything she does or is told to do within three steps or seconds. Of course, it goes without saying that she is not totally dumb. Taokaka often gives nicknames to those she meets so she can try to easily remember them later. She does actually know who they are, but prefers the nickname routine.

Of course, much of her simple-minded traits can be compared to how a cat's mindset actually works, especially when it comes to how fascinated by things she can be (such as a pair of breasts) or how her mind tends to seemingly drift away from more serious things.

By nature he should be a peaceful person that doesn't like fighting, but for some reason he holds animosity towards the protagonist's group.
A married woman with big breasts. She is a serious and strict Japanese teacher. 25 years old and loves on the third floor of the apartment complex. She was Noa's junior in college.
She and her husband are very much in love. He is currently a student at law school. He is financially dependent on Hina.
From official site
Shuuji was born in Mikazejima. Previously residing in Tokyo, he accepted the transfer school invitation from his cousin sister, Rika, at the Suzumori Acadamy. He's good at cooking.
Roughly translated from Chinese wikipedia.
She is a third-year student who is the student body president and vice-chairman of the committee.
She is very popular among some boys because of her small body size. She is always serious, but is often pushed around by the committee members.
From official site
"Shall we first start with a kiss?"
Keyword: Love
The hero type who specializes in love who wants to always be an ideal lover.
He acts like a stylish composed adult and uses this to his advantage; however it undeniably feels somewhat fake.
Faction: Asmodian
Skill: Preto Armada (Puretto Arumaada)
Artist: Mikoyan
Card: AS 4 Stars EX
The president of the library committee and Nanami's senpai. He always listens to her troubles and is very kind to her.

The main character's childhood friend. With his father being a manga artist and his mother a cosplayer, he himself also grew to love anime and manga. Starts off as chubby like the main character but due to her influence decides to start dieting as well. He's always a bit timid or shy, blushing often when the character or Onii-chan compliments him.

He worries about the character on her diet and later he goes to the US coming back slim and as handsome as the others, after not being able to eat the food properly and coincidentally breaking his glasses and switching to lens.
Edited from Wikipedia

The school nurse at Inamura Academy. A beautiful woman with glasses. She is tolerant of students skipping classes, but is terrified of those who are injured in fights. She is well versed in eroticism, even bringing masturbation equipment (sex toys) onto campus, and is tolerant of students' sexual activity (but does warn them), but becomes extremely flustered when she witnesses it in real life. She is a smoker, and as a hobby she has installed a large industrial ventilation fan in her room without permission, and sometimes plans to conduct human experiments using suspicious chemicals that require notification to the government.
She is drinking buddies with Saeko, and whenever Saeko gets out of control, she is forced to listen to complaints about Saeko's brother (she even prepares a doll to take her place).
Edited from Wikipedia
One of the maids tending to the Overlords in the Great Overlord's castle. Very bright and jolly.
Sometimes a bit too jolly...

The strict class president, who also serves as disciplinary committee chariman. She is a stickler for rules and regulations, and cannot be negotiated with. While she likes her reputation among the students, she also has a much more girly side. Has a complex about her small size.
"This is a lot different from your average figure. Just look at these moving parts!"
An old friend of Casty and Sarly. He is currently missing.
He encountered Ion while he was running a Bios Shop, and helped her and Casty on their travels.
He has a detail knowledge of idols and figurines, and knows a great deal about sub-culture.
He has something of a geeky way of speaking when discussing his passions, including "Moe", but he is also a talented hacker and held a key position within a prominent hacking clan.
He is very knowledgeable on Wave Science, computer hacking, and Genometrics Networking.
From the English official site

She is a young mother with a baby. However, perhaps because she is too young, she lacks the self-awareness of a mother. For example, she leaves her son at the daycare center to go to the gym, or she doesn't want to change his diaper.
She is very sociable and can easily make friends with anyone, especially Sakura, and they sometimes go out for drinks together.
She is friend's with Sakura's who runs a day-care center, where she takes care of her child at a friend's price.
From Getchu

The bright leader with good manners and high social influence. He's the founder of Liar-S' predecessor, S-leeper. Because he can immediately open anyone's heart, he has many acquaintances in the industry. He's a fast-thinker who learns the ropes of everything easily.
Translation of official website character profile.
Childhood friend of Hiroyuki and Akari. Member of the soccer club, his friendly personality makes him very popular.
Kanade's mother and former vocalist. She died in accident couple of years prior to the story.
She was the one who put "Deardrops" guitar picks in vending machine. It was her dream that they bound some people to a great rock-band in the future.

Members of St. Aile’s SORD team. Sylvie and Vel are third years, and therefore upperclassmen to Gumi and the others; as older students, they are allowed to wear nuns' habits instead of regular uniforms. They work as a pair during missions.
"Hey there, terrorist scum! You makin' sure to 'love thy neighbor'?"
From official site

A demon of the night endowed with great magic that guards the second floor. Fascinated by ninja for some reason, she's read a large number of books about them that she collected from who knows where. Despite the books, she has a lot of misconceptions about ninja. Someone needs to teach her that a female ninja is a kunoichi and that 'coward' and unfair' are not words of praise.

Yuudai and Akiho's daughter. She doesn't hold much affection for her father, who isn't normally home. She's also trying to get along with her step-mom, Natsuki, with no success. Therefore, she is very interested in the more friendly protagonst.
Leader of rock band 'Black Teresa'

Rintarou is an eccentric individual, a self-proclaimed mad scientist and often refers to himself under the alias of Hououin Kyouma, which is also the name he uses to introduce himself to other people. Mayuri and Daru refer to him by the nickname Okarin, a portmanteau of his surname and given name. He is the founder of what he calls the "Future Gadget Laboratory" in Akihabara where he spends most of his time. Rintarou gives off the appearance of being delusional and paranoid, frequently referring to the "organization" that is after him, talking to himself on his phone, and engaging in fits of maniacal laughter. Most of the time he takes on a fairly arrogant personality. He is usually seen wearing a lab coat.
As he experiments with time travel, he learns that he is the only one who possesses the ability to determine changes between different timelines, which he dubs "Reading Steiner".
The character is 18 years old and a first year student at Tokyo Denki University.
Modified from Wikipedia.
"You gotta play dirty now and then to survive in the world."

The young landlady of an inn in a seaport town. The western-style building used to be someone's private property before being renovated into the inn. Nanae doesn't seem too serious about her hotel business, considering the fact that they only have a couple of people in a year as guests at the inn.
The inside of the building is adorned with antique furniture that she has personally purchased overseas.
Treating everyone equally, she is loved by all the local kids. She met Sachiko by coincidence and discovered a good chemistry between them.
From Fruitbat Factory
A second-year at Asakura Academy. One half of Kouhei's newfound twin daughters.

Her personality is very carefree and relaxed, and a bit airheaded sometimes. She likes to make up strange songs and hums a lot. After she suddenly became Kouhei's daughter, she didn't particularly seem to mind, not questioning it and just obediently going along with it.

A girl with Dissociative Identity Disorder who was convicted of killing 12 people in a hospital in 2009. As a result, she was sent to SPHIA for treatment. She is said to have 11 separate personalities.
Shinji's younger sister.
A real estate agent, whom Kae consults about the strange happenings in her apartment.
Cat breed: Somali Cat
Perverted friend of protagonist that is often trying to get him to look at beautiful women with him. Has an uncanny skill of disappearing right before they get caught.
The president of James Entertainment.
She was impressed by the protagonists enthusiasm during her interview and personally hired her.
Kotori's mother.
The main character's fiancé.
She is also a base-based operator and a good programmer.
She used to be a famous hacker.
Married woman having an affair with a younger boy. She is in her late 20s.
Personality wise, she is calm. A little natural.
She is infatuated with a younger boy and apparently, she is on a secret trip to a traveler's lodge.
From official site

Hikari's childhood friend whom Tsuu's squad also found while investigating the underground caverns. Though his eyes give an aggressive first impression, Mamoru is a kind and thoughtful boy who gets along with everyone, and becomes an important to ally to Tsuu's squad. He is usually found guarding the base as the gatekeeper, and supports the Blood Maidens as a handyman of sorts.
He is also the protagonist for the prequel novel.

The Natsuki that Tsukumo finds alongside another... Tsukumo. In this temporality, Tsukumo ("Onii-san") managed to save Natsuki from her accident, however he finds himself in "double copy" in his temporality (present time). He then decides not to interact with them so as not to destroy the temporal flow (or something like that) but a fight between his other him, Natsuki (who loses consciousness) and thugs force him to intervene.
Being the same Natsuki that the player knows since the beginning of the game, she keeps all the attributes of her counterpart, just her role and her health state changes.
Seen only in the third chapter.
Sakura 's pet(?) dog.
Ace is a knight at the castle. He is always smiling and laughing, even when disposing of the countless assassins sent for him each day. He has an awful sense of direction.
Narrative Writer
Eureka Software's lead narrative writer.
Always wearing headphones, Saki is a self-centered girl who doesn't listen when people talk to her and goes about things the way she feels like.
She always wears a track suit and looks younger than she is due to her short height and cute looks.
She was the writer for the original version of Dreams and Reality - Nie, the Witch, and the End of the World that they are remaking now and is a veteran of Eureka Software.
She's always going "roar!!" so people call her Tinysaurus.
From Official site
Sannoudou Ouji's older brother.
Hayami Reika is the 1st daughter of Hayami Reiko. Cold and unapproachable, she isn't thrilled about her new brother's arrival.
Former commander of the HOUNDS.
Likes: Beni shouga, candy, beef bowls
Dislikes: Cleaning
"Ha, ha, you got me. But in my defence, I don't just invite anybody."

A teacher at New Sieg Academia who oversees the guidance of students in the senior high school division. As he can put himself in the students' shoes and relate when counselling the students, he has their utmost trust. Perhaps because of his gentle personality, he's also quite popular with the female students.
A mysterious acquaintance of Tokio's, known for their digital skills.
Hobbies: Watching YuoTube.
Favorite foods: Candies and marshmallows.
"I didn't mean it like that. But every time I noticed, I ended up being alone."
She is a 1st year at Kazami Academy and a part of the Active Club.
She essentially expressionless and doesn't have much of a reaction.
She absentmindedly looks at the sky, plants, and animals all by herself.
It's not like she has a cold personality. She has a frivolous existence because her class has a tough time approaching her.
As she was dozing around the place where Hibiki was dancing, she joined the Active Club based on the flow that was going on.
She seems to have a favorite YuoTube channel to watch and often checks those videos during break time.
Translated from Official Website
"Lies are like dreams you've woken up from."
From the tale "Urikohime to Amanojaku."
A darling young girl living in a mountain village. She is quick-witted, and she often throws Shirohime off with her precocious, teasing remarks.
From ANIPLEX.EXE
Protagonist of the story, transported to another world when given special item in the FPS game he played.

A young voice actress of middling popularity who has just made her debut. Her shy and introverted personality is at fault for her lack of acting jobs, however she has another persona as "Ruin", an immensely popular Vtuber.
Isumi is vexed by the gap between Ruin's persona and who she really is.

Isumi joined the voice acting profession because she liked games and anime, however she learnt quickly as an intern that it is necessary for successful VAs to engage with the public as part of the job description. Having no confidence in her outward appearance, she has turned down multiple requests for public appearances which has adversely impacted her voice acting career.

She took up the Vtuber role of "Ruin" because it was guaranteed that she would not need to face the public. However, the growing popularity of her virtual persona (over a million subscribers) and the lack of recognition plus low pay because of the contract terms with Ruin's agency lead to growing frustration as Isumi has not given up on her dream of being a successful voice actress and has no intention of just anonymously voicing a virtual persona.

After talking to Isumi regarding her lack of popularity, Kiichi proposes to help Isumi out of her current predicament as he correctly assesses she is not capable of breaking out of her current situation alone. Although his proposal is outlandishly reckless, he is successful in getting Isumi out of her contract with help from the Vatican's backers.

If Isumi is not given up to the ark, her new found confidence and innate talent as a voice actress allow her to rise up the ranks at a phenomenal pace. She gives Kiichi her social contact details and remains grateful to him for helping her pursue her true calling. Rumours of her previous identity as Ruin are also quashed with Kiichi's assistance.

She commissions Kiichi in the third game of the trilogy to find the podcaster who has once again dredged up rumours of her alter-ego Ruin as part of her standard fare of shock-jock entertainment. When Kiichi finds out the podcaster is Rimika, she asks him to be lenient to Rimika as she does not hold a grudge. Depending on Kiichi's actions, she even reconciles with Rimika as the pair have a surprising amount in common. Her popularity is even greater in the third game than it was in the second, to the point she barely has any free time to meet Kiichi when he's on the job to receive status reports.
A colleague of Kazuma Kamikubo. She is a professional hair and makeup artist.
Drummer of "Teiji Taisha" and also an office worker. A gentle and reasonable person.
Soul Less is a member of a thief gang living in a cave in the northeastern part of Helman near Golak and Vladivostok. She's the daughter of the old Boss of the group and the sister of Bound Less.

She's a passionate and energetic girl, but since she was raised among thieves she's quite violent and tomboyish. She never received a proper education and is mostly illiterate. She's interested in studying but only about things that would be useful for her, such as fighting strategies (though she does show interesting in learning to read after receiving a letter from her brother). She lives a happy and carefree life as a thief.
From AliceSoft Wiki
La Vaswald is a goddess of destruction in the hierarchy of Gods created by Supreme God Harmonitt.

She was created for the role of serving as an agent of destruction that would annihilate the Protagonist Race if in the case that pollution of Souls became too high and could become troublesome for the Reincarnation Cycle. However, as this event never even came close to taking place, she was deemed worthless and the Supreme Gods Planner and Roven Pan split the goddess into two angel knights, La Saizel and La Hawzel, and gave them as a gift to Demon King Gele. Gele turned the twins into Dark Lords, who pledged their loyalty to the demon king.

Because the two were originally a single entity, the pain and emotions one feels are shared by the other. It is entirely possible for them to merge again into La Vaswald, which would result in the obvious death of the Dark Lord sisters.
From AliceSoft Wiki
Affiliation: 24 Wards Heinous Crimes Prevention Unit
Role: Chief Director
Deeply insightful and very conscientious and sympathetic. Consequently, his popularity is amazing. Kotobuki doesn't directly go out into the field, but he provides crucial support from the sidelines.
Cases are never solved by chasing them, from Kotobuki's point of view. "You have to wait patiently." He is a man who knows how to manage people.
From the in-game profile
